name: Vorkath

mechanics.name: Acid Pool Barrage
mechanics.description: Vorkath spits acid pools across the arena, then rapid-fires dragonfire at your position.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep moving. Standing in acid damages you.

mechanics.name: Zombified Spawn
mechanics.description: Vorkath freezes you in ice and summons a zombified spawn that walks toward you and explodes.
mechanics.counterplay: Kill the spawn before it reaches you. Crumble Undead one-shots it.
